sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Black Hole Solitaire lies a simple yet engaging gameplay mechanic. The game consists of a deck of cards, with each card featuring a unique value. The objective is to move all cards to the black hole by counting up or down in value. Sounds easy, right? Well, it's not as straightforward as it seems. The game features three peaks of cards, with the top peak being the most accessible. Each peak has its own unique set of challenges and opportunities, and it's up to you to navigate through them to reach the black hole. With each move, you'll need to strategize and think ahead to maximize your chances of success.

One of the key features of Black Hole Solitaire is its card-removal system. Cards can be removed from the game in either ascending or descending order, depending on the peak they're in. This adds a layer of complexity to the game, as you'll need to carefully plan your moves to ensure you're always removing cards that will help you progress. The game also features a 'freeze' mechanism, which allows you to temporarily lock cards in place, giving you more time to think and plan your next move.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter various obstacles and challenges that will test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. From stuck cards to complex sequences, Black Hole Solitaire will keep you on your toes and push you to think creatively. With its engaging gameplay mechanics and addictive nature, Black Hole Solitaire is a game that will keep you hooked for hours on end.

The game also features a 'Hint' system, which provides you with suggestions and advice on how to progress.
